citation.title: Application of a Machine Learning-Based Topology Optimization Method on an Automotive B-Pillar for Crashworthy Lightweight Design
citation.authors: Jirair Aroyan, Johannes Sperber, Christopher Ortmann, Axel Schumacher
citation.venue: MATEC Web of Conferences 422, 03010 (2026); conference paper, CC BY 4.0 per Crossref licence metadata (licence start 2026-09-09). The DOAJ PDF file name refers to EngOpt 2026 [inferred from the file name]
citation.version_coded: none; only the abstract was read (pool record, OpenAlex and DOAJ metadata)

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no full text). The abstract reports voidML cut the B-pillar patch mass from 2.413 to 2.141 kg (11.3%) in 48 iterations and 191 crash analyses, with force-intrusion curves close to the reference; no classical comparator is named.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: not coded (no full text); the abstract states no time or speed comparison with a classical method

notes: Screening code was I-UNCLEAR. Access attempts on 2026-09-24, all with a generic User-Agent and no login: (1) doi.org, which redirects to www.matec-conferences.org, returned HTTP 403 with a DataDome CAPTCHA page (one earlier attempt failed on DNS, then resolved); (2) the /pdf URL listed by OpenAlex and Crossref returned 403 with the same CAPTCHA page; (3) the DOAJ full-text link (articles/matecconf/pdf/2026/04/matecconf_engopt2026_03010.pdf) returned 403; (4) the full_html and abs pages returned 403; (5) WebFetch on the PDF returned 403. No CAPTCHA bypass was attempted. OpenAlex reports no repository copy (any_repository_has_fulltext false); a web search found no other legal copy; no arXiv version was found. Content known from the abstract: gradient-boosted decision trees predict a displacement-field deviation for candidate voids in a crash-loaded thin-walled patch, and a design tree runs several candidate designs in parallel. The abstract names no classical comparator; if the full text also has none, FT-NOBASELINE would apply. Scope note for the verifier: crash (explicit nonlinear dynamics with plasticity and contact) is not in the protocol's physics list (§3.1), but it is not in the excluded list either. Related record: P00879 (Structural and Multidisciplinary Optimization 2026, doi 10.1007/s00158-026-04348-0, same four authors) is the voidML method article, a different paper, so it is not a duplicate of this application paper. No author named Jun Wang.
